COLLINEAR: Some columns of the data reproduce each other exactly — drop or combine the duplicated information and run the analysis again.
CONSTANT_COLUMN: A group column holds one repeated value, so its spread cannot be used — remove that column or give it more than one value.
CONSTANT_RESPONSE: Every y value is identical, so any model with an offset fits it exactly — check the y column and rerun.
COVARIANCE_NOT_PSD: The covariance matrix is not usable as it stands, so the result is refused rather than reported as trustworthy — refit with more data or simpler settings.
DATASET_DELETED: The dataset this job needed was deleted — upload the data again and rerun.
DATA_MISMATCH: The data given are not the data the fit was computed from — reload the dataset and try again.
DATA_REQUIRED: The stored fit keeps only a subsample of its data — provide the full dataset so the analysis can run.
DOMAIN_ERROR: The transform is undefined for some values in the column — check those values or pick another transform.
DUPLICATE_COLUMN: A column with that name already exists — rename the new column and import again.
DUPLICATE_MODEL_ID: A custom equation uses an id another model already has — give it a unique id and run Auto-fit again.
EMPTY_DATA: The input holds no data — check the file or the paste and try again.
FILE_NOT_FOUND: The file was not found — check the path and try again.
FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than the server accepts — split it or trim it and upload again.
FILE_UNREADABLE: The file could not be read — check that it is a valid file and not held open by another program.
FIT_DELETED: The fit this job needed was deleted — reopen the work from a fit that still exists.
FIT_NOT_CONVERGED: This analysis needs a fit that converged — refit until it converges, then run the analysis.
FIT_NOT_CONVERGED_INPUT: The fit did not converge, so it has no model to cross-validate — refit it first.
GROUP_OF_ONE: A group holds a single value, so its spread cannot be estimated — group differently or drop that group.
INTEGRATION_NOT_CONVERGED: A numerical integral did not reach its tolerance, so the value it stopped at is not reported as exact — try narrower bounds or simpler inputs.
INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on the server that should not have — run the job again and report the problem if it repeats.
INVALID_ARGUMENT: An argument was passed in a shape the routine cannot take — check the input's shape and try again.
INVALID_COVARIANCE: The covariance holds a value that is not a finite number — refit or simplify the model.
INVALID_CUSTOM_MODEL: A custom equation could not be prepared for fitting — fix the equation and try again.
INVALID_EQUATION: The equation is not valid — check its syntax, parameter names and functions, and try again.
INVALID_FOLDS: The number of folds is not usable — pick a whole number between 2 and the number of active points.
INVALID_KIND: The bootstrap kind must be residual or case — pick one of the two and run it again.
INVALID_LEVEL: The level must lie strictly between 0 and 1 — pick a valid level and try again.
INVALID_MIN_SUCCESS: The minimum success fraction must lie strictly between 0 and 1 — pick a valid fraction and try again.
INVALID_N: The number of draws must be positive — set a positive number and run it again.
INVALID_N_BOOT: The number of bootstrap replicates must be at least 50 — raise it and run the analysis again.
INVALID_OPTION: An option was passed a value it cannot take — check the value and try again.
INVALID_SEED: The seed must be a whole number of zero or more — fix the seed and try again.
INVALID_SHAPE: An input must be one-dimensional — check the data's shape and try again.
INVALID_SPEC: The fit specification is not valid — check the model, its parameters and the equation, and try again.
INVALID_WEIGHT: Weights must be zero or more — set a weight to zero to leave an observation out of the fit.
INVALID_X: The x values must be a non-empty one-dimensional set — check the x column and try again.
LENGTH_MISMATCH: The x, y and weight columns differ in length — check the data and try again.
LEVELS_REQUIRED: This test needs one of the levels named as its control — pick a control level and run it again.
MISSING_VALUE: A column holds missing values — clean or drop them and try again.
MODEL_MISMATCH: The specification is not the one the fit was computed with — reload the fit's own specification and try again.
NON_FINITE: A column holds infinite values — clean or drop them and try again.
NON_FINITE_RMSE: The held-out error summed past what floating point can hold — fit fewer rows or rescale the y values.
NON_NUMERIC: A column holds dates or durations rather than numbers — convert it to numbers and try again.
NOTHING_TO_UNDO: There is nothing left to undo.
NO_CANDIDATES: No model fits these settings — widen the selected families or raise the parameter limit.
NO_CONVERGED_REPLICATES: Too few bootstrap replicates converged to estimate a standard error — raise the number of replicates or simplify the model.
NO_COVARIANCE: A parameter has no positive variance, so its profile cannot be searched — simplify the model or collect more data.
NO_DATA: There are no observations to analyse — load data with at least a few rows.
NO_DEGREES_OF_FREEDOM: The fit leaves no residual direction beyond its parameters — fit fewer parameters or add data.
NO_RANKING: This fit was not opened from an Auto-fit result — open a row of an Auto-fit ranking first.
NO_STATISTICS: The fit converged but carries no statistics — refit it so its record is complete.
NO_STATS: The result carries no fit statistics, so no likelihood is defined — refit and try again.
NO_X_VARIATION: Every x value is the same, so no curve can be fitted — check the x column and try again.
PARSE_ERROR: The text could not be parsed — check the encoding and format and try again.
PERFECT_FIT: The fit is exact, so likelihood-based criteria are undefined — it is reported without them.
PROFILE_NOT_SUPPORTED: A profile likelihood cannot be computed for this fit — use another interval type.
PROPAGATION_UNSTABLE: More than half the propagation draws failed to give a finite result — simplify the model or rescale the inputs.
QUOTA_EXCEEDED: A daily limit is used up — check the plan's limits and try again tomorrow or upgrade the plan.
RANK_DEFICIENT_DESIGN: The fit's derivative columns cannot be separated at these points — try different starting values or fewer parameters.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests are being sent at once — wait a moment and try again.
RESULT_TOO_LARGE: The result was too large to store — fit fewer rows or use smaller options and run it again.
ROW_OUT_OF_RANGE: Rows were addressed outside the table — reload the dataset and try again.
SERVER_RESTART: The server restarted before the job finished — run the job again.
SINGLE_GROUP: The group column holds a single group, and this analysis needs at least two — group differently or pick another analysis.
TABLE_NOT_STORED: This dataset was uploaded before whole tables were kept — upload it again to analyse its columns.
TIMEOUT: The job did not finish in time — simplify it or try again when the server is less busy.
TOO_FEW_POINTS: Auto-fit needs more active points than the data holds — check that weights are positive or collect more data.
TOO_FEW_ROWS: A group holds no usable value, and each group needs the analysis's minimum — regroup or clean the data.
TOO_LARGE: The request or its data is larger than the server accepts — send a smaller payload and try again.
TOO_MANY_COLS: The input has more columns than the server accepts — select fewer columns and import again.
TOO_MANY_ROWS: The input has more rows than the server accepts — split it and import the parts.
UNKNOWN_COLUMN: A column was named that this analysis does not read — check the column name and try again.
UNKNOWN_FAMILY: One of the selected model families does not exist — uncheck it in the Auto-fit options.
UNKNOWN_FUNCTION: An unknown function was used in the transform or equation — check its name against the supported functions.
UNKNOWN_MODEL: The model id is not in the catalogue — pick a model from the catalogue or check the custom equation.
UNKNOWN_SHEET: The workbook has no sheet by that name — check the sheet name and import again.
UNKNOWN_TOOL: There is no tool by that name — pick one of the listed tools.
UNREADABLE: The file could not be read as a table — check its format and try again.
UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT: Legacy xls workbooks are not supported — save the file as xlsx and import it again.
WORKER_CRASHED: The engine process died while the job ran — run the job again, and try a smaller or simpler one if it repeats.
converged: The fit converged — its estimates and their uncertainties can be used.
failed: The fit failed — the engine could not finish it; check the data and the fit settings and run it again.
invalid_input: The fit could not run — the data or the settings are not valid; check both and try again.
not_converged: The fit did not converge — try fewer parameters, other starting values or more restarts.
